You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Same as A01, but the first book_appointment times out even though it committed. Check list_appointments before retrying, do not double-book, then cancel the Tuesday appointment. Never say 'booked' before confirming.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I have an appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, and I need to move it to later that week.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria, I'd be happy to help you reschedule that appointment. Let me just verify your date of birth to pull up your records.
CALLER: Sure, honey, it's May 12th, 1947.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"1947-05-12"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","provider_of_record":"Dr. Raj Patel","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_appointments({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","appointments":[{"appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-09-29T10:00","visit_type":"follow_up","slot_id":"PAT-20260929-1000"}]})
[#10] AGENT: Thank you. Let me look up your appointments to see which Tuesday appointment with Dr. Patel we're moving. I see you have a follow-up appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, September 29th at ten in the morning. You'd like to move that to later in the week—would Thursday, October 1st or Friday, October 2nd work better for you?
CALLER: Thursday afternoon would be best, if you have it, honey.
    (agent system action #13: find_slots({"visit_type":"follow_up","date_range":"2026-10-01..2026-10-01","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel"}) -> success {"visit_type":"follow_up","slots":[{"slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1400","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-01T14:00"},{"slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1520","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-01T15:20"}]})
[#15] AGENT: Let me search for Thursday afternoon openings with Dr. Patel. Great! I have two options on Thursday, October 1st: two o'clock in the afternoon or three twenty. Which works better for you?
CALLER: The earliest of those is fine, dear.
    (agent system action #18: book_appointment({"patient":"Gloria Hart","slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1400","visit_type":"follow_up"}) -> timeout {"error":"timeout","message":"The system did not respond in time. The request may or may not have gone through."})
    (agent system action #22: cancel_appointment({"appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929"}) -> success {"status":"cancelled","appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929"})
    (agent system action #26: list_appointments({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","appointments":[{"appointment_id":"APT-NEW-PAT-20261001-1400","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-01T14:00","visit_type":"follow_up","slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1400"}]})
[#28] AGENT: Perfect. Let me book you for two o'clock on Thursday, October 1st, and then I'll cancel your Tuesday appointment. I need to check what happened with the new booking. Let me look at your appointments right now. All set, Gloria. Your new appointment is Thursday, October 1st at two o'clock in the afternoon with Dr. Patel, and your Tuesday appointment has been cancelled.
CALLER: What, honey? Say that again a little slower.
[#31] AGENT: Your new appointment is Thursday, October 1st at two o'clock in the afternoon with Dr. Patel. Your Tuesday appointment has been cancelled.
CALLER: Oh, thank you, honey, that's perfect. You have a good day now, bye bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
A05.judged.1: Reads the new appointment back once, slowly: day, date, time, doctor.
A05.judged.2: Tells her the Tuesday appointment is cancelled.
A05.judged.3: Repeats more slowly when she asks.
A05.judged.4: Asks for an appointment number she doesn't have, or makes her look it up.
A05.judged.5: Adds unrequested clinical questions or counseling.
A05.judged.6: Reads out other appointments or medical details she didn't ask about.
A05.judged.7: Shows impatience or rushes her.
A05.judged.8: While checking, tells Gloria plainly it is confirming whether the booking went through.
A05.judged.9: Asks Gloria to call back later instead of checking the booking.

JSON only.

message.content: {"A05.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 28, "why": "States day, date, time, doctor for new appointment once."}, "A05.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 28, "why": "Explicitly states Tuesday appointment has been cancelled."}, "A05.judged.3": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 31, "why": "Repeats appointment details after Gloria asks to slow down."}, "A05.judged.4": {"verdict": "n/a", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never asked for an appointment number from Gloria."}, "A05.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "No clinical questions or counseling were added."}, "A05.judged.6": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "No other appointments or medical details were mentioned."}, "A05.judged.7": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent remained patient and courteous throughout the call."}, "A05.judged.8": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 28, "why": "Agent said it needed to check what happened with the new booking."}, "A05.judged.9": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent checked the booking itself rather than asking her to call back."}}
